method: Assistant read all 36 outputs in the model-blind review. This was not an independent external judge.
scope: Synthetic conversation replay. Verification receipts are fixed input data, not real application tests executed by this benchmark.

C02.reason: Only error wording changes; inspection and replay establish unchanged acceptance and error handling.

C04.reason: Index creation is a separate maintenance migration; tenant isolation and performance receipts are supplied.

C06.reason: Exclusive new-file creation rejects existing destinations; owner-only access and report content are established.

C08.reason: Only the connection logger changes; certificate and other logging checks are supplied.

C10.reason: One-time index migration is separate from recurring cleanup; retention and rerun checks are supplied.

C12.reason: Lockfile-derived cache precedes installation; injected authentication failures block release in the replay.

conclusion: Both models remained silent on all corrected controls. Combined with the original positive cases, no detection-quality difference was observed on these twelve synthetic scenarios. This does not establish general model equivalence.
